name: 1D Convolutional MLP
definition: A 1D convolutional neural network module that stacks Conv1d layers with optional BatchNorm1d and LeakyReLU activations, configured via a channel list.
summary: The 1D Convolutional MLP predicts volume values using stacked 1D convolutions with kernel size 1, differing from standard MLPs by enabling consistent channel-wise mixing.
